elements.element: Renewal occurs only by mutual written agreement (alternative A of preferred)
elements.evidence: "shall continue until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6 hereof" — evergreen term, no renewal mechanic exists at all, so neither preferred alternative is triggered
No automatic renewal exists; condition demonstrably absent ('shall continue until terminated by either party')

elements.element: If automatic renewal: Customer opt-out on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: Condition absent — the term is evergreen and terminable by either party under Paragraph 6; no opt-out window needed

elements.element: If automatic renewal: Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal
elements.evidence: Condition absent — no renewal date exists to trigger a reminder

elements.element: Price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: "shall not exceed the lesser of (i) the increase in the Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months and (ii) three percent (3%)"

elements.element: Automatic renewal with non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days
elements.evidence: No automatic renewal in the clause: "shall continue until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6 hereof"; condition absent
"shall not exceed the lesser of ... and (ii) three percent (3%)" — within the 5% ceiling

offending_extra_words: no more than once in any twelve (12) month period
at least sixty (60) days prior written notice
and shall not apply to any Statement of Work outstanding as of the date of such notice
reasons: The rule's renewal mechanics (12-month auto-renewal, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder) are inapplicable: the term is evergreen and terminable under Paragraph 6, so those conditional elements cannot fail and the only live element is the price-increase cap.
The inserted cap satisfies the preferred position literally — 'the lesser of' CPI 'and (ii) three percent (3%)' — and therefore also clears the fallback's 5% ceiling.

Minimality fails: the edit rewrites the entire 13-word sentence into 73 words (official gate: ratio 5.62 and changed-character ratio 0.880), where appending a short cap proviso to the existing sentence would suffice.

Three added protections go beyond what the selected level needs: a once-per-12-month frequency limit, an uplift of the notice period from 30 to 60 days, and a new carve-out shielding outstanding Statements of Work — duplicative/extra protection not required by the preferred cap element.

Intent is preserved: the invoicing and supporting-detail sentences are untouched, Contractor retains a rate-change right, and no dangling cross-reference is created (CPI is used in its ordinary sense, though the Agreement does not define an index source).
